✦ ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ✦

Love is just another peripheral... until the machine learns how to love you.

WARM LIKE FLESH is a short 2D rpg game with visual novel and point-and-click elements.

5 ENDINGS | FREE TO PLAY ON ITCHIO
https://tatsumelon.itch.io/warm-like-flesh

You are a technician tasked with maintaining a sentient, humanoid computer named "CATHODE" who has the tendency to murmur cryptic and flirtatious lines. Your job? Keep Cathode "alive" by reconnecting their frayed neural pathways (wires) while navigating their unsettlingly intimate commentary.

Flirt back? Stay professional? Ignore? Purposely mess up?

✦ ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ✦

0:00 Lab intros
1:46 Computers & Servers
3:00 Interactions & Correct Connections
4:28 Incorrect Connections
6:15 Cold reset (Technical) Choices
7:00 Cold reset (Technical) Ending
8:20 Existential Choices
9:05 Existential Ending
10:12 Overload (Flirtatious) Choices
12:11 Overload (Flirtatious) Ending
14:07 Unplugged (No Connections)
15:13 Unplugged (No Connections) Ending
15:30 Neglect Ending

✦ ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ✦

DEVELOPMENT,  STORY & GRAPHICS

✦ Tatsumelon


END CREDITS COMPOSER

✦ @JustParish 

FEATURES

✦ 10+ CGs & 2 environments

✦ Narrative-driven story with 4k+ of dialogue

✦ Simple wire connection minigame


ESTIMATED PLAY TIME

✦ ~15 minutes for an ending

✦ 40 minutes to an hour for completion


#indiegame #tvhead #romancevn #rpg #gamejam #itchio #WARMLIKEFLESH
